intent: Follow June’s last afternoon through sunset, woodland shadows and lantern light to the quiet threshold of the storm.

sections.name: The last afternoon fields
sections.lesson: Follow the warm light towards the ridge

signs.text:
The last afternoon fields
Follow the warm light towards the ridge

The sunset ridge
Climb into the last sunlight

sections.name: The shadowed woodland
sections.lesson: Keep below the dark woodland branches

signs.text:
The shadowed woodland
Keep below the dark woodland branches

sections.name: The lantern countryside
sections.lesson: Use the lanterns to read the old stone passages

signs.text:
The lantern countryside
Use the lanterns to read the old stone passages

sections.name: The storm’s quiet threshold
sections.lesson: Cross the last dark terraces · the keeper waits beyond
